# FastPress Skills

The agent-ops kit behind FastPress Labs: three installable skills plus zero-dependency companion scripts.

## Install

`npx skills add fastpresspages/skills`

## Skills

- fastpress-release — ship a new project end-to-end using the FastPress Labs playbook (name research, standard kit, audit loop, Pages, release, cross-links).
- fastpress-teardown — weekly public field scans of fresh launch pages with a removal-on-request policy. Companion script `skills/fastpress-teardown/scripts/hn-top.mjs` (read-only HN picker).
- fastpress-support — triage the one inbox into audit / deal / collab / support / spam and answer honestly. Companion script `skills/fastpress-support/scripts/triage.mjs` (stdin classifier).

## Facts

- Apache-2.0, zero runtime dependencies, Node >= 18.17, no telemetry.
- Scripts are read-only by design; agents following the skills never auto-submit forms or send mail.
- Site: https://fastpresspages.github.io/skills/ (privacy.html and terms.html disclose the form pipeline).

## Related

- LaunchGrade: grade launch pages (54 checks) - github.com/fastpresspages/launchgrade
- RepoGrade: grade repos (33 checks) - github.com/fastpresspages/repograde
- Org: github.com/fastpresspages
